Likewise, fine-tuning one 4B model on only 204 trajectories cannot demonstrate that static datasets or memorization are intrinsically insufficient.

Some headline statements contradict Table 1: GPT-5.1 does not outperform every standard model on every category (50% on QT2-IF versus Gemini-2.5-Flash's 54%, and 44% on QT4-3-IF versus Qwen3-235B's 48%). The latency conclusion is also based on OpenRouter wall-clock measurements, which confound model computation with provider/network and sequential tool overhead.

The LLM-judge and error analyses remain incomplete: only 70 cases are used for agreement validation, the audit of judge-declared failures does not estimate false-positive acceptance, and the manual error taxonomy lacks annotation procedures or agreement statistics. Safety, privacy, and security implications of the claimed real-device deployment are not discussed.
